takeaways.text: Azure and other cloud services grew 29% (30% in constant currency), and Microsoft Cloud overall reached $36.8B — about 57% of all revenue — as AI demand pulled customers onto the platform.
takeaways.title: Azure is the growth engine

takeaways.text: Microsoft Cloud revenue hit $36.8B, up 21%. The flip side of the growth story: the cost of revenue rose 17% as Microsoft built out the data centers behind it.
takeaways.title: The cloud is most of Microsoft now

takeaways.text: Xbox content and services revenue jumped 61%, but 58 points of that came from the Activision acquisition — the underlying games business grew much more slowly, and Windows OEM revenue rose just 4%.
takeaways.title: Xbox got an acquisition lift

verdict: Microsoft grew 15% to $64.7B as Azure jumped 29% and Microsoft Cloud revenue hit $36.8B — and it kept $22.0B as profit, about 34 cents of every dollar.
